title: Elon Musk on Joe Rogan denies advanced tech

tellings.quote: Now Elon Musk recently said on Joe Rogan he has an all access pass through Lockheed and Northrup and we don't have any of these technologies.

plain: Elon Musk recently said on Joe Rogan's show that he has an all-access pass to the defence contractors Lockheed and Northrop and that the US does not have any of these advanced, supposedly hidden technologies. Michels puts this to his guest, the UFO activist Steven Greer, in 2025, as a public denial from someone well placed to know whether such secret craft exist.
